evidence_items.explanation: User comparisons collected June 10–25 show newer frontier models outperforming preceding models on image-containing conversations. Preference measurements are imperfect, but this is independent evidence of improvement within the target quarter.

OlympicArena independently finds a clear gap favoring the newer models on difficult multidisciplinary problems. The same abstract says overall performance remains unsatisfactory; that limits claims of reliability but does not establish stalled improvement.
